description: Find Scribase tools that are not listed here, by task or by toolset (database, schema, schedules, services, branches, observability, mobile, platform, org, backups, import). Returns names, descriptions and input schemas; run one with call_tool. No arguments lists the toolsets.

query.description: What you want to do, in plain words, e.g. `run a cron job every night`. Optional.

toolset.description: List every tool of one toolset, e.g. `schedules`. Optional.

name: search_tools
title: Find more tools
